data.name: Maroti Sorgekar
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Maroti Sorgekar has made a big mark in cricket. With 16 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 25, with an average of 15.91 and a quick strike rate of 132.58. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 3 sixes and 21 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 9.0 overs, taking 4 wickets at an economy rate of 12.00. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
